row.date_enacted: May 5, 2026 (Tuesday), per GPB/The Current reporting on the Camden County Board of Commissioners meeting, which is corroborated by the earlier May 2, 2026 article reporting the vote was scheduled for 'Tuesday.'
row.legal_basis: Camden County Board of Commissioners resolution adopting a 6-month moratorium on data centers, adopted May 5, 2026 with the exclusion of sections 4, 5, 6, and 7 of the proposal as originally drafted by District 3 Commissioner Cody Smith.
row.trigger: Growing statewide concern about energy-hungry data center operations, amid a contemporaneous Kingsland rezone vote
